name: Squircle Avatar Generator
description: Image upload tool that crops a photo into an adjustable squircle avatar with drag repositioning, zoom, shape presets, and PNG export at several resolutions.
contents: Upload card with drag and drop zone
Editor card with canvas preview, shape presets, shape and zoom sliders, resolution picker, reset and export buttons
behavior: Drop or pick an image file up to the size limit
Drag the image inside the canvas with mouse or touch to reposition
Shape slider morphs from circle to square using a superellipse curve
Export downloads a transparent PNG at the chosen size
Editor stacks vertically on small screens
